def.en: The parts of the body covered by underwear. They belong only to you and are kept private.
def.hg: Body ke woh parts jo underwear se dhake rehte hain. Yeh sirf tumhare hain aur private rakhe jaate hain.

def.en: The body part between the legs that most boys have. Urine comes out through it.
def.hg: Pairon ke beech ka woh part jo zyadatar ladkon ke paas hota hai. Isse urine bahar aata hai.

def.en: Two small, round parts that sit in a soft bag of skin just behind the penis.
def.hg: Do chhote, gol parts jo penis ke theek peeche skin ki ek soft thaili mein rehte hain.

def.en: The outside private part between the legs that most girls have. It has soft folds of skin.
def.hg: Pairon ke beech ka bahar wala private part jo zyadatar ladkiyon ke paas hota hai. Isme skin ke soft folds hote hain.

def.en: The soft, round part of the body that you sit on. It is a private part too.
def.hg: Body ka woh soft, gol part jis par tum baithte ho. Yeh bhi ek private part hai.

def.en: A grown-up who listens to you and keeps you safe, like a parent, grandparent or teacher. You can tell them anything.
def.hg: Aisa bada insaan jo tumhari baat sunta hai aur tumhe safe rakhta hai, jaise mummy-papa, dada-dadi ya teacher. Tum unhe kuch bhi bata sakte ho.

def.en: The stretchy, muscular passage inside the body that connects the vulva to the uterus. Period blood leaves through it.
def.hg: Body ke andar ka stretchy, muscular passage jo vulva ko uterus se connect karta hai. Period blood isi se bahar aata hai.

def.en: A sensitive organ at the top of the vulva. Only its small tip is visible; most of it lies inside the body.
def.hg: Vulva ke top par ek sensitive organ. Iska bas chhota sa tip bahar dikhta hai; zyadatar part body ke andar hota hai.

def.en: A pear-sized muscular organ in the pelvis, also called the womb, where a baby can grow during pregnancy.
def.hg: Pelvis mein naashpati ke size ka muscular organ, jise womb bhi kehte hain; pregnancy mein baby yahin grow karta hai.

def.en: Two small organs beside the uterus that store egg cells and make the hormones oestrogen and progesterone.
def.hg: Uterus ke paas ke do chhote organs, jinme egg cells store rehte hain aur jo oestrogen aur progesterone hormones banate hain.

def.en: Two oval organs inside the scrotum that make sperm and the hormone testosterone from puberty onwards.
def.hg: Scrotum ke andar ke do oval organs, jo puberty ke baad se sperm aur testosterone hormone banate hain.

def.en: The tube that carries urine out of the bladder. In a body with a penis it also carries semen.
def.hg: Woh tube jo bladder se urine ko bahar le jaati hai. Jis body mein penis hota hai, usme semen bhi isi se nikalta hai.
